paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Shisha; Shabbat 60a, according to Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: דק״ס is read contextually as Dikdukei Soferim, the source to which Hyman attributes Acha bar Shisha. No new witness collation is claimed, and no extra numeral 60 is attached to that title. ס. gives Shabbat 60a under the period convention.

קו. gives Pesachim 106a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Earlier machine ם./דק״ם and קי, differ from supplied ס./דק״ס and קו. The two attestations do not establish a single father; both Rav titles are full.
